summary: Off-registry HTTP dependency source controls installed code
details: package.json declares its sole dependency `cache-format-syntax-tracer` as a bare HTTPS URL (https://artifacts.creditslib.com/npm/cache-format-syntax-tracer) rather than a registry version range. On `npm install`, npm fetches whatever bytes that URL returns and executes any lifecycle scripts contained inside, with no version pin and no integrity check. The shipped index.js is a thin stub that re-exports the dependency, so the manifest line plus the remote host effectively constitute the entire installed payload. The @flexmr-scoped package name combined with a stub proxying to an off-registry host matches the dependency-confusion shape, and whoever controls artifacts.creditslib.com controls code executed on every installer's machine. The fetched content can also change at any time after publication without any update to this package.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
